page.overview:
Who is Slifer Red?

Slifer Red, known as Osiris Red (オシリス・レッド Oshirisu Reddo) in the Japanese version, is a location in Yu-Gi-Oh! GX. It is the lowest-ranked dormitory at Duel Academy and is mostly made up of students with the poorest grades and Dueling skills. The headmaster of the dormitory was originally Lyman Banner until his death (as Amnael, the seventh Shadow Rider) when his body was destroyed following his Duel against Jaden Yuki; however, his pet cat Pharaoh swallowed his spirit to prevent him from leaving.

The dorm is named after the Egyptian God Card, "Slifer the Sky Dragon", which was previously owned by Yugi Muto/Yami Yugi during the Battle City tournament in the Yu-Gi-Oh! anime. Its low ranking is based on how Yugi is bitterly viewed by his rival, Seto Kaiba (who serves as the academy's owner), but the students are very determined and nearly always pull through, which is Yugi's most defining trait.

Being the lowest-ranked dormitory at Duel Academy, the Slifer Red dorm is designed to have poor accommodations and poor catering. The dorm features small living spaces, forcing some students to sleep in bunk beds, and a smaller cafeteria where tiny portions of food are served in tiny dishes in trays. To enroll in Slifer Red, the student must have poor grades and poor Dueling skills with a weak Deck, causing them to lose. The state of the dorm is likely designed as an incentive for the students to either try advancing to a higher dorm and acquire a better standard of living, or leave the academy. When Chazz Princeton moved in, he made the interior of the dorm more luxurious for the students.

The Slifer Red students are usually identified by red uniform jackets with white trimmings that extend to the waist. The uniform jacket also features a red band at the cuffs, a white band around the shoulders with a button to keep the jacket closed, and a white decorative shape with a crimson border on the chest of the jacket. The collar of the jacket usually sticks straight up and is also red with a crimson border. Another band, which matches the color of the jacket, wraps around the bottom of the jacket and has a snap or button to keep the jacket closed (although Jaden Yuki keeps his jacket open). There is a variant for second-year or higher Slifer Red students like Chumley Huffington who wear a different colored jacket, where the red and the white color schemes (except for the crimson-colored borders, the buttons, the band wrapped around the bottom of the jacket, and the decorative shape on the chest of the jacket) are swapped.
